نقتدي (form VIII)
# نَقْتَدِي (naqtadī) /naq.ta.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَدَى (iqtadā)
# نَقْتَدِيَ (naqtadiya) /naq.ta.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَدَى (iqtadā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
